notes.title: Update (1.4)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

It's been a while since the last announcement, but here we are again with something new. 

To begin with, we come up with a new update 1.4 and here is the list of changes that are made:

Majors:

[list][*] Enemies will no longer attack heroes who cannot act. This includes the Lasnah “Plant prison.”
[*] Fixed a bug that removed a turn from a status when returning to the previous hero during a fight.[/list]

Minors:

[list][*] The apple tree in the back forest now drops other apples depending on the progress in the game.
[*] Changed the display of hero statistics on the menu and Max's “Previous memory” skill.
[*] Change the display of item descriptions on the menu to 2 lines instead of just 1.
[*] He no longer has a pain sound if a hero suffers 0 damage.
[*] He no longer has a selector sound if he only has 1 enemy.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash after this one.
[*] Fixed various display bugs. 
[*] Credits update.[/list]

This update also brings the game's participation in the Steam Turn-Based RPG Festival 2024. As a result, the game will be on discounts throughout the event.

Now is the right time to get the game with an improved version. Remember to give your opinion of the game on the Steam page or on the Discord here: https://discord.gg/MaeJTr76Br. 

Every feedback is always greatly appreciated.

Thank you and good game.

notes.title: Progress Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I come to you with the progress of the last month. This one was devoted mainly to the correction/programming of the beginning of act 2.

So I'm going to talk a bit about what the beginning of this next act will be.

You start the act in the village of “La Guadeloupe” (where Max's father's apartment is located
in act 1) and it will now be fully open. You will now have access to locations that were blocked in Act 1.

In these maps, there will be several secondary objectives to do, you will have the choice to do the ones that interest you the most in order to be able to progress in the main story.

For any comments, come join the discord: https://discord.gg/MaeJTr76Br.

notes.title: Progress Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I am writing to you today to share a bit about the progress of the project and I will try to do it more often.

First, here is an overview of the shop system that will be added at the start of Act 2.

There will be 2 types of shops, the first is the classic “Purchase” type, which will, of course, be used to fill the inventory. It will mainly be grocery stores, convenience stores and others.

The second type will serve as “Healing” where we can only heal on the spot, but at a better quality/price ratio.

Note that nothing is final and may be subject to change. For any questions/suggestions, come join the Discord here: https://discord.gg/MaeJTr76Br.

notes.title: 1 year anniversary sale and update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hi there,

I come to announce that the project is celebrating its 1 year of release. To celebrate the event, I am offering you the 1.3 update as well as a 25% discount. The discount is valid until Monday, September 19, 2022.

As for the update, here is the list of changes that have been made:

Majors:
[list]
– ¹Change karma choices at the end of Act 1. (The choice has been reversed for more common sense.)
- A hero's passive status now retires at the end of the turn of its pre-determined duration and not at the start of the next turn's actions.
– Fixed a bug that caused the turn duration of a different status to be shown in the menu.
[/list]

¹The following change will make old saves that were created after the Caim fight obsolete.

Minors:
[list]
– Fixed saving bug at the end of Act 1.
– Fixed a bug that allowed the book to be open during a new skill alert.
– Fixed the bug that always displayed the same help in the “Game over” screen.
– Fixed the menu in the “Game over” screen.
– Fixed an appearance bug that displayed the appearance of an enemy in standby even after being defeated.
– Fixed the bug that displayed the appearance of an enemy on top of heroes in combat.
– Correction of some texts in the English version.
– Credits update.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this announcement, feel free to join my networks and share the news.
 
Join the “Discord” here: https://discord.gg/MaeJTr76Br
The “Facebook” page here: https://www.facebook.com/Creas-1537482953193775
 
Thanks and good game.

notes.title: Update (1.2)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I come to announce the 1.2 update of the 1st act, here are the few changes that been brought.

I remind you that you can always join the game’s official “Discord”. Come to discuss the project, give your impressions/comments and report any bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I am here to announce the first update of Act 1, here are the changes that have been made.

—Fixed a bug that could occur during combat when using a rune to heal.
—Combat balancing vs. Caim and his servants.

That’s all of the update. Small, but necessary. However, that’s not all. I’m also announcing a 10% discount for the Halloween sale 2021. Take the opportunity to get the game at a discount.

I also invite you to the official discord of the game. You can come there to discuss the project, give your impressions/comments and also report any bugs.

The Discord link: https://discord.gg/MaeJTr76Br

We hope to see many of you there to discuss the project with you.

notes.title: Official release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am updating on the current status of my Creas game.

I am honoured to announce that Creas will officially release on Friday, August 20, 2021, on Steam and Itch.io.

By the same token, I am also announcing that the cost of the first act of the game will be CA $5.69 (USD 5 or €3.99), notice that all income received will remain for the progress of the game. Either in equipment or in graphic/musical resources.

There will also be two new Steam features added, “Cloud” save and achievements. In addition, the game can be played on Linux with the “Proton DB” tool.

Thank you all for your support and encouragement and I hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Demo available.
notes.notes:
As part of the Steam Neo Fest, the Creas demo is now available to the public. Don't hesitate to take a look and share your thoughts. All returns are accepted.

Quick reminder, I will be playing the live demo on June 22 at 7 p.m. EDT. Be there.
